## Load your data

```{r}
nhanes <- readr::read_csv(
	"examples/nhanes-equity/data/nhanes_equity_v6.csv",
	show_col_types = FALSE
)
```

## Descriptive BMI Summary

```{r}
summarize_bmi <- function(data) {
	data |>
		dplyr::filter(
			!is.na(IncomeGroup),
			!is.na(Gender),
			!is.na(BMI)
		) |>
		dplyr::group_by(IncomeGroup, Gender) |>
		dplyr::summarise(
			n = dplyr::n(),
			mean_BMI = mean(BMI),
			sd_BMI = stats::sd(BMI),
			median_BMI = stats::median(BMI),
			.groups = "drop"
		) |>
		dplyr::arrange(IncomeGroup, Gender)
}

bmi_summary <- summarize_bmi(nhanes)

bmi_summary
```
